Saylor Direct Credit

Current offer. Free learning with a separate credit examination. Current Saylor University branding does not by itself establish institutional-origin transfer classification.

Research profile · confirm exact school and course acceptance

How the credit works

ACE recommendations for selected Direct Credit courses; ordinary completion certificates are insufficient.

Pace and learning format

Self-paced preparation and self-scheduled assessment; current FAQ states a 14-day retake wait and three-attempt maximum.

Costs to check

Official FAQ lists free study/transcripts and $5 per proctored attempt. Check each credit exam remains available.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Pass the designated proctored Direct Credit exam; an ordinary certificate final does not produce the credit recommendation.

Before you commit

  • Choose the exact receiving school, degree, and catalog year.
  • Confirm this specific course, recommendation or transcript source—not only the provider’s name.
  • Ask which requirement the learning will satisfy and check duplicate-credit, grade, date, and source limits.
  • Keep a written school decision before paying for an outside course you need for graduation.
